The enclosing square is \(4\times 4\), so its area is \(16\).

The unshaded regions are three triangles:
- The left notch has base \(4\) and height \(1\), so its area is \(\frac12(4)(1)=2\).
- The upper-right triangle has legs \(2\) and \(2\), so its area is \(\frac12(2)(2)=2\).
- The lower-right triangle also has area \(2\).

Thus the unshaded area is \(2+2+2=6\), so the shaded area is
\[
16-6=10.
\]

\[
\boxed{10\text{ square units}}
\]
